title: The quantified immune-aging dysregulation index: a large-language model-powered method for annotating and quantifying systems-level dysregulation

live_model.evidence: Sec. 2.2: "natural language processing of enriched processes was performed via an API node using GPT-4.1-nano"; Table 2, "LLM mean TENSE" over 100 iterations.

prompt.location: Sec. 2.2/2.4.1 (full DIRES 'D'-category classifier system prompt quoted, incl. output contract, self-check, anchors, override rule)
prompt.note: Same structure is reused serially for the I, R, E, S categories with category-specific definitions swapped in; only the D-category instance is quoted in full.

claim.metric: mean TENSE score vs. human-consensus reference (Bias of the Mean)
claim.location: Table 2 (100 iterations of GPT-4.1-nano; reference TENSE 0.248, LLM mean 0.242, RBM -2.7%)

data.source: Enrichr/Reactome pathway annotations (public); transcriptomic module (TM1/TM9/TM10) from the published Sparks et al. (2024) WGCNA study; prompts in Supplementary File 1

notes: Paper states the 100-run TENSE calculation used '100x5x38 = 1,540 total prompt iterations'; note 100*5*38 arithmetically equals 19,000, so actual call count may be higher than the printed total — flagged here rather than silently corrected. Also benchmarks Claude Haiku 4.5 as an alternative classifier (not in scope: not an OpenAI still-callable id).
